seoTitle: How to Delete Your GoDaddy Account Permanently
metaDescription: Cancel all active GoDaddy subscriptions, domains, and services, then permanently delete your account and remove your billing data.
intro: Closing a GoDaddy account for good involves more than just clicking delete — you need to cancel active subscriptions and domains first to avoid leftover charges. This guide walks through what to check before closing your account, using the current dashboard and privacy settings, so your personal and billing data is properly removed.

steps.heading: Cancel active subscriptions and services
steps.body: Review your GoDaddy dashboard and cancel any active hosting, domain, or add-on subscriptions before proceeding.

steps.heading: Handle your domains
steps.body: Decide whether to let domains expire, transfer them elsewhere, or cancel them as part of the account closure process.

steps.heading: Review privacy and billing settings
steps.body: Check what personal and billing data is stored on your account and what will be removed once it's closed.

steps.heading: Submit the account deletion request
steps.body: Follow the steps in your dashboard to formally cancel and permanently close your GoDaddy account.

faq.question: Do I need to cancel subscriptions before deleting my GoDaddy account?
faq.answer: Yes, canceling active subscriptions and domains first helps avoid ongoing charges after the account is closed.

faq.question: Is deleting a GoDaddy account reversible?
faq.answer: The guide treats this as a permanent closure, so it's worth reviewing everything carefully before submitting the request.

faq.question: What happens to my domains when I delete my account?
faq.answer: You'll need to decide whether to transfer, let expire, or cancel them, since this affects what happens once the account is closed.

faq.question: Why would someone delete their GoDaddy account?
faq.answer: Common reasons include no longer using GoDaddy, switching providers, or wanting to remove personal and billing data from the platform.
